'''Wince''' was a member of the [[Siluria III resistance]] under [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]]. During the assault on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor's]] mansion on [[Siluria III]], Wince's prowess with a rifle, along with a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]], was instrumental in the resistance's victory.
